assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: corrective action - material unwanted event control at PSV-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-4210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during shift handover while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 3 April 2023 a corrective action on PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
